observation: User navigates to #return-review while Marrowline continuation is incomplete; Loom displays standard builder shell rather than the expected returned-work review.
concern: Route confusion and broken promise: operator is told they have returned to review, but the interface fails to visibly inhabit the return consequence, violating consequence-before-ontology.
falsifier: A first-time mobile user can locate their returned work without reading technical console logs when returnWorkspaceVisible is false.
recommended_action: Display child-legible notice when Return is reached prematurely: 'No finished work to review yet. Finish your turn in Marrowline or start over.'
